text:
maria: quick heads-up — proposal to deprecate top-level `region_preference` param in the /v1/generate api in favor of a namespaced `routing.hints` structure. want to confirm contract+rollout plan.

ken: +1 to namespacing. main questions: 1) backward compat for existing SDKs, 2) response changes, 3) metric tagging for routing decisions.

ashok: can you paste the expected request/response examples? small diff helps reviewers.

maria: sure — sample request we plan to accept for the next 2 releases (compat mode):
```json
POST /v1/generate
{
  "model": "redwood-3b",
  "prompt": "Summarize...",
  "routing.hints": {
    "region": "eu-west-1",
    "tier": "standard",
    "prefer_fallback": "region_then_tier"
  }
}
```

maria: old param will still be accepted for reads for 2 months but will be ignored for writes after the cutoff.

sylvie: for responses — are we renaming `model_id` -> `model_used`? customers asked for clarity when model aliasing happens.

ken: yes we should add `model_used` (string) and keep `model_id` for two releases with a deprecation warning header `X-Deprecated-Field: model_id`.

luke: quick edge-case: if `routing.hints.region` is provided but the preferred model has no region variant, fallback order should be: explicit variant -> same-tier global -> cross-tier regional? we should be explicit.

ashok: propose fallback algorithm in docs: 1) exact model variant match (model+region+tier), 2) other variants in same region preferring higher-tier, 3) same-tier in other regions, 4) last resort: global compatible variant. will add example table.

maria: +1. also want the API to return the routing decision metadata in `routing_decision` small object: `requested_hints`, `chosen_variant`, `fallback_reason`. this helps customers and our cost dashboards.

ken: that is fine but note agents.md: we need to avoid deep response changes. Keep `routing_decision` as optional and opt-in via `?debug_routing=true` query param for first release.

maria: ok opt-in toggle sounds good. we'll add the field only when debug flag is present.

luke: who owns the swagger/schema change PR? @ken can you do the api-schema PR and add migration notes for SDKs?

ken: I can pick it up. will include example curl and the deprecation timeline. pinging @deploy-bot to schedule canary window? :robot_face:

deploy-bot: scheduled canary for eng-platform on 2024-08-15 08:00 UTC — window 2 hours. releasing to canaries: route-change + debug flag enabled.

ashok: also need a short test matrix for QA: 1) old clients with `region_preference`, 2) new clients with `routing.hints`, 3) missing hints, 4) debug_routing=true. i'll draft and push to test-plan repo.

maria: timeline proposal: api-schema PR this week, eng-review + sdk-migration notes next week, canary mid-Aug, full rollout 2 weeks after canary if no regressions. sound reasonable?

ken: sounds good. I'll include regression alerts tied to token-cost deltas and latency SLO in the console dashboards.

sylvie: tiny note for docs: show explicit example of the `X-Deprecated-Field: model_id` header and what to do.

maria: thanks all — tagging the PR when ready. if anyone wants to pair on the migration notes LMK. :thumbsup:
